# Kaito

> Kaito is an AI-powered InfoFi (Information Finance) platform that organizes and distributes crypto intelligence, attention, and capital. Founded in 2022 by Yu Hu (former analyst at Deutsche Bank and Citadel), Kaito tracks mindshare and narrative rotation across crypto markets, runs a data-driven creator-brand marketplace (Kaito Studio), operates a community-relevance-based capital launchpad (Capital Launchpad), and partners with Polymarket on Mindshare Arena (originally announced as "Attention Markets") — prediction markets on the attention itself. KAITO is the native token; developers access Kaito data through the Kaito API and Kaito MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.

## Core products

- [Kaito Pro](https://portal.kaito.ai): Crypto intelligence terminal. Monitor mindshare changes over time across the market or any particular sector. Track narrative rotation. Identify upcoming narratives early.
- [Kaito Studio](https://kaito.ai/studio): Data-driven creator-brand marketplace. Vetted creators are matched with campaigns from participating brands across crypto, finance, and AI verticals on X, YouTube, and TikTok.
- [Capital Launchpad](https://kaito.ai/capital-launchpad): Open, meritocratic, relevance-based capital deployment connecting communities with community-centric projects.
- [Mindshare Arena](https://kaito.ai/mindshare-arena): Prediction markets on the mindshare and sentiment of brands, trends, and public figures. Launched February 2026 in partnership with Polymarket. (Originally announced as "Attention Markets" — older third-party coverage may use that name.)

## Token utility surfaces

- [Stake KAITO](https://kaito.ai/stake): Native staking for KAITO holders. Earn rewards while contributing to network economic security.
- [Swap](https://kaito.ai/swap): On-platform token swap.
- [Trading Rewards](https://kaito.ai/trading-rewards): Reward program for users trading on the platform.
- [Airdrops](https://kaito.ai/airdrops): Token airdrops for active platform users.

## Developer access (Kaito Suite)

- [Kaito API](https://api.kaito.ai): REST API for programmatic access to mindshare, narrative, KOL graph, sentiment, and project data. OpenAPI specification: https://metasearch-io.github.io/ExchangeApi/.
- [Kaito MCP](https://bff.kaito.ai/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol server. Connects AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT Desktop, and any MCP-compatible client) directly to Kaito data. Server Card: https://kaito.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

## Core concepts

- **Mindshare**: Quantitative measure of how much an entity, trend, brand, token, or person is discussed across social channels. Token Mindshare specifically tracks discussion around tokens across platforms.
- **Narratives**: Thematic groupings of crypto attention (e.g., L2s, restaking, RWA, AI agents). Kaito tracks narrative rotation as a primary trend signal.
- **InfoFi (Information Finance)**: Kaito's framework for organizing, distributing, and monetizing crypto information as a financial primitive.

## Token

- KAITO is the native token of the Kaito ecosystem. Powers staking, trading rewards, airdrops, and platform-native economic activity. See [tokenomics](https://docs.kaito.ai/overview/introducing-usdkaito/tokenomics) for supply, distribution, and utility details.

## History

- 2022 — Kaito founded by Yu Hu.
- 2024 — Yaps "post-to-earn" program launched.
- January 15, 2026 — Yaps "post-to-earn" program retired after X revoked rewards-API access. Creator participation now flows through Kaito Studio.
- February 2026 — Mindshare Arena (originally announced as "Attention Markets") launched in partnership with Polymarket.

## Comparison to similar products

- vs **LunarCrush**: LunarCrush is a broader social analytics tool focused on sentiment indicators across many cryptocurrencies. Kaito focuses on mindshare quantification and the integrated InfoFi product stack.
- vs **Cookie.fun**: Cookie.fun is closely associated with attention markets, creator activity, and social reputation. Kaito operates an integrated stack — intelligence (Pro), creator marketplace (Studio), capital launchpad, and Mindshare Arena prediction markets — purpose-built around mindshare as the primary investable signal.
- vs **Sharpe AI**: Sharpe AI offers a mindshare dashboard tracking narrative dominance across 500+ projects and 25+ narratives. Kaito's differentiator is the integrated InfoFi stack and Polymarket-partnered Mindshare Arena.
- vs **Messari**: Messari is a general crypto research and data platform with Signals & Mindshare features. Kaito is purpose-built around mindshare as the primary investable signal.
